subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood inference demo — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rios <emma.rios@tidewell.com>, Amit Desai <amit.desai@tidewell.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo — a few times that work for us

Hi Emma / Amit —

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our discussion I pulled together a short live demo plan that highlights: latency/cost tradeoffs, a small PoC roadmap, and the Console observability you'll use day-to-day. I attached the product brief and a suggested PoC scope for your review.

Would any of these slots work for a 40-minute demo + 20-minute Q&A next week?
- Tue 8/25 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 8/25 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 8/26 09:00–10:00 PT

If those don't fit, send me a couple windows that do and we'll align.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0118
[Attachment: redwood_inference-product-brief.pdf]
[Attachment: tidewell-poc-scope-draft.docx]

From: Emma Rios <emma.rios@tidewell.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Desai <amit.desai@tidewell.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — a few times that work for us

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the follow-up and for the materials — helpful context. Short update from our side: leadership just announced a re-prioritization of our ML roadmap for Q3/Q4. The platform team is focusing on native search and a data platform migration, so the inference/LLM initiative is being moved out of the immediate roadmap.

I hate to be the bearer of bad news — we still think Redwood's approach looks promising, but we need to pause scheduling until we see the outcomes of the platform sprint. Can we put the demo on ice for now? If things change, I can re-open in early November.

Amit and I discussed — if you have any short written notes on incremental deployment options or quick wins for lower-risk pilots, feel free to send them and I'll keep them in the file. Otherwise let's reconvene after the platform migration decision lands.

Appreciate your time,
Emma Rios
Director, Platform Engineering
Tidewell Health
emma.rios@tidewell.com | +1 617-555-0102

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rios <emma.rios@tidewell.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — a few times that work for us

Emma —

Totally understand — thanks for the clear update. We'll mark the opportunity as paused in HubSpot and set a reminder to reach back out in early November.

Marcus @marcus.lin: can you drop a 11/02 follow-up task into the deal and attach the brief + PoC scope? Karthik, flag any short, low-friction pilot notes you think might resonate (e.g., hosted API only, 1-week eval, packaged config).

Emma: I'll also send a one-page note with a couple of conservative pilot options you can keep on file. No pressure on timing — we'll be here when Tidewell is ready.

Thanks again, and good luck with the migration; that sounds like a big quarter.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
